robotPhases.stowed: Stowed, waiting for the next case
robotPhases.driving: Driving in on the laser crosshair

events.theatreIn: {patient} is wheeled into the robotic theatre.
events.robotDocked: The da Vinci 5 (simulated) is docked for {patient} ({procedure}). Docking took {minutes} min.
events.robotUndocked: The da Vinci 5 (simulated) is undocked from {patient}. Console time was {minutes} min.
events.theatreOut: {patient} is wheeled out after {minutes} min in the robotic theatre.
events.turnoverDone: The robotic theatre is clean and ready after {minutes} min.

checklist.signIn: Sign-in (before anaesthesia): identity, consent, operation site, allergies and airway risk confirmed.
checklist.timeOut: Time-out (before the first cut): the whole team agrees the patient, the operation, the site, antibiotics given and the images on screen.
checklist.signOut: Sign-out (before the patient leaves theatre): the operation recorded, the swab, needle and instrument counts correct, specimens labelled, recovery plan stated.
checklist.recoveryDischarge: Recovery discharge criteria: awake and orientated, steady breathing, pulse and pressure, pain and sickness controlled, dressing dry, passed to the ward or home with a nurse.
